name: Tres Dawg
summary: **Tres Dawg** is a [[kind:cultivar|cultivar]] bred by [[breeder:Top Dawg Seeds]], a cross of [[chemdawg-d|Chem D]] and [[double-dawg|Double Dawg]], the latter itself a cross of Chem D and Afghani #1. Crossed again with [[chemdawg-4|Chemdawg 4]], it later parented [[stardawg|Stardawg]].
